entities.summary: The Federal League, also known as the League of the Free Peoples, was a short lived confederation of provinces located in South America. From 1815 to 1820 it tried to establish a confederal organization for the State that was emerging from the May Revolution in the war of independence against the Spanish Empire in part of what is now Uruguay, Argentina and Brazil.
